note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it for about nine to eleven seconds: their elemental resistances fall by 20% to 39%. One curse at a time, unless the character can hold more; bosses take a third less.

def.name: Brittle Doom
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they lose elemental resistances.

note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it for five to six seconds: normal and magic enemies act 20% to 29% more slowly (rare and unique ones half as much), and effects on them, such as bleeds, run out 40% more slowly.

def.name: Leaden Limbs
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they act more slowly, and effects on them last longer.

note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: normal and magic enemies deal 21% to 30% less damage (rare and unique ones about half as much), with less accuracy, 25% less critical strike chance and a smaller critical multiplier.

def.name: Feeble Grip
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they deal less damage, hit less often and crit less.

note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: they take 30% to 39% more physical damage, and more physical damage over time, and attacks have a 20% chance to make them bleed and a 20% chance to maim them.

def.name: Open Wounds
def.description: Curses enemies in an area: they take more physical damage, and may be bled and maimed by attacks.
